scope: Local source review only; neither helper nor any remote command was executed by reviewer.
checks: Fixed ordinary UID1000 and regular development path, separate from /opt production; existing .git or symlink refuses before copying.
Independent source HEAD must be f8ac8a5 and APPbc4 must be ancestor; tracked dirty source refuses.
Every selected destination is preflighted against its actual previous inventory SHA256, with separate exact old dev-helper H. A newly occupied unknown path refuses rather than overwrites.

A second per-file before-H check precedes private backup; each replaced old file is privately saved and its H verified. Replacement is via a new temporary file and atomic rename, not in-place hardlink mutation.
Old entire ledger must be a byte prefix of qualified source before and after; no JSONL reconstruction or raw-line merge.
Migration private backup is owner-only0700; no delete/cleanup of unknown paths, runtime data or dependencies.
Git init/local object fetch/update-ref/read-tree without -u only creates Git objects and index. There is no reset, checkout or clean and no Git working-tree replacement.
The only runtime command is dev --check: occupied ports can refuse, but no dev server or production service is started.
Deferred ops source delivery binds old APPbc4/clean checkout, exact bundle H and imported targetf8; only fast-forward merge in the independent source directory, not regular user data or production.

Concurrent external writers still require an observed quiet synchronization window; no ordinary user-space rename promises atomic compare-and-swap against an uncooperative editor.

limits: No sync completion, Git import, new dev --check or production result is asserted.
The script preserves the paths outside its qualified tracked target inventory; it does not claim all user data is Git-clean.
All backup evidence and existing user/history/runtime directories must remain retained.
Root must run the ops delivery and synchronization serially after the ongoing activation session ends.
